propositions: A ticket with a live supersedes or duplicates link cannot be closed with --class=superseded or --class=duplicate because the plan-review close gate does not receive the close disposition and unconditionally demands a plan-review attestation.

The plan-review attestation is unsatisfiable by construction for a superseded ticket, because the reviewer correctly blocks on findings like 'this work already exists', making the gate an unreachable exit that forces use of --force and degrades the audit trail.

The completion-verification gate already exempts administrative dispositions with live-link evidence, but the plan-review close gate was never given the disposition parameter and cannot implement the same exemption.
A force-close of a superseded ticket strips the completion signature from its entire ancestor epic chain, preventing certification of parent tickets.

The fix must thread close_class and tracker parameters to close_plan_review_gate_check, exempt only link-backed dispositions (superseded and duplicate) with verified live links, and emit a distinct verdict to distinguish evidence-backed closes from type exemptions.
